issues.name: Recent update removed basic features and users are unhappy
issues.summary: Customers say a recent update made the app less useful, removed basic music player features, and leaves them disappointed.

issues.name: Basic playback controls locked behind Premium paywall
issues.summary: Customers report that choosing specific songs, unlimited skipping, and playing the next track now require a Premium subscription.

issues.name: Frequent ads interrupt listening for free users
issues.summary: Customers complain that ads play after every song or two, with no long stretches of uninterrupted music unless they pay for Premium.

issues.name: Music stops halfway and voice assistant fails to play
issues.summary: Customers report playback stopping mid-song, failing to resume where it left off, sound adjustment bugs, and Google Assistant not playing songs.

issues.name: Cannot log in and app shows false no-internet error
issues.summary: Customers say they cannot log into their account, and the app reports no internet connection even though other apps on their phone work.

issues.name: App reports no internet despite working Wi-Fi connection
issues.summary: Customers report the app says there is no internet connection or randomly stops playing while other apps and Wi-Fi work normally.

issues.name: Redesigned interface hard to use and missing features
issues.summary: Customers dislike the new update's design, saying songs will not play as expected, lyrics are missing, and queue additions are unavailable.

issues.name: App crashes or fails to open after latest update
issues.summary: Customers report the app crashes or will not open following the latest update, sometimes showing a black screen.

issues.name: Music blocked after subscribing to Premium
issues.summary: Customers say that after paying for Premium they see a paused subscription screen and cannot access or play their music.

issues.name: Many songs and full tracks unavailable in catalog
issues.summary: Customers say many songs are absent, including underrated titles, and that some tracks only offer a short clip instead of the full song.

issues.name: Recommendations ignore settings and disregard preferences
issues.summary: Customers say the app keeps recommending songs into their playlists even after recommendations are turned off, and criticize the artists and content promoted.

issues.name: Shuffle-only playlist controls and limited skipping
issues.summary: Customers report the new menu only allows shuffle, shuffle repeats the same songs, and skipping is limited to six songs in a playlist.

issues.name: Tapping songs plays unintended tracks or demos
issues.summary: Customers report that tapping a liked song opens unrelated songs or demos, plays random tracks, and that video and audio-only podcasts cannot be switched.

issues.name: Lyrics missing or inconsistently displayed
issues.summary: Customers say lyrics appear for some songs but not others and sometimes fail to load for songs in their playlists.

issues.name: Downloads fail and storage move deletes content
issues.summary: Customers report downloads not starting and that moving storage failed and deleted their downloaded content.

issues.name: Downloaded music will not play offline
issues.summary: Customers report offline mode not working and being unable to listen to music offline or log in without internet.

issues.name: Downloads stall in background and questions paid value
issues.summary: Customers say downloads get stuck in the background until Spotify is opened, and question the value of paying for Premium.

issues.name: Users uninstall app over unrelated political protest
issues.summary: Customers say they are uninstalling the app to protest a political matter unrelated to the app's functionality.

issues.name: Account hacked and playlists cannot be recovered
issues.summary: A customer reports their account was hacked, playlists from last week cannot be recovered, and they feel they are paying for nothing.

issues.name: Podcast playback lags for paying subscribers
issues.summary: A Premium customer reports that certain podcasts have suddenly started lagging.

issues.name: Cannot skip back a few seconds during playback
issues.summary: A customer reports they cannot rewind a few seconds to replay part of a song.

issues.name: Charges to listen or replay music seem excessive
issues.summary: A customer says there are too many charges to listen to or replay music, which is why they dislike the app now.
